verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs call it a drop-in replacement for Terraform that preserves existing workflows and configurations, and say it is backwards-compatible. It reads `.tf` files alongside `.tofu` files, and `tofu import` brings in existing resources. Community users independently describe migration as just `s/terraform/opentofu/g` and report moving several client projects over. missing for 10: an explicit first-party migration guide, documented compatibility of existing Terraform state files (the state half of the story is only implied), and notes on version-compatibility limits.
